title: STORY2DIFF: A Dataset Linking Real-World User Stories to Code Changes
abstract: arXiv:2610.39872v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Research on requirements-to-code tasks needs examples in which a genuine requirement is paired with the change that implemented it. Existing user-story collections, however, largely contain isolated or synthetic text. To address this limitation, we present STORY2DIFF, a dataset of 7,785 English user stories linked to merged pull requests from January 2017 to July 2026. The dataset is mined from a set of 982 public Java and Python repositories. Each record in the dataset combines the original issue, extracted Connextra elements, the associated pull request and commit metadata, a file-level diff capturing the code changes introduced by the associated pull request, and the affected files before and after the change. The tool we built to mine STORY2DIFF can be used to repeat the automatic extraction of the records, using different parameters (e.g., a different timeframe). The dataset can support a variety of tasks, including requirement

tldr: 提出了STORY2DIFF数据集，将7,785个真实用户故事与已合并的拉取请求及其代码变更相关联，为需求到代码研究提供了真实配对的数据资源。
en_tdlr: The paper presents STORY2DIFF, a dataset of 7,785 real-world user stories linked to merged pull requests and file-level code changes, mined from 982 public Java and Python repositories to support requirements-to-code research.
